title: _strip_heredocs discards the rest of the opening line, so cat <<EOF > out names no target
detail: _HEREDOC_RE removes from << through the closing delimiter, including everything after the marker on its own line. 'cat <<EOF > out', 'cat <<EOF; rm a', 'cat <<EOF && rm a', 'cat <<EOF | tee x' and '<<EOF rm a' all reach the gate with that text gone, for the write scan, deny_commands and the lease check alike. Only the body is data. A second heredoc on one line also leaves its body as commands. Measured on 0.238.2.
